FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF BIOPHYSICS
BMS BLOCK–II, SOUTH CAMPUS, SECTOR-25, PANJAB UNIVERSITY
CHANDIGARH-160014
Advertisement for the post of Junior Research Fellow: Applications are invited for the position of
Junior Research Fellow in the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) sponsored research
project entitled “Development of a novel antibacterial and antibiofilm coating for biomaterial
implants and medical devices” sanctioned to the undersigned.
Essential Qualifications: The Candidate must have passed the M.Sc. with a minimum of 55%
marks in Biophysics/Biochemistry/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Allied fields AND have cleared
GATE/NETJRF/lectureship (UGC-CSIR joint test)/ICMR/Panjab University’s Ph.D. entrance test
or any national level examination.
Desirable Experience: Prior knowledge of computational studies, molecular structure
characterization, and microbiological techniques.
Emoluments/Fellowship: The selected candidate will be paid stipend of Rs. 31,000/- pm + 18%
HRA as per Central Govt. / Panjab University Rules.
Duration: Initial appointment for one year, extendable based on performance. The position is
temporary and co-terminus with the project.
How to apply:
Candidate possessing the above-mentioned Educational Qualification and are having a
maximum of 28 years of age for JRF as on the date of the interview (relaxable by 5 years for
SC/ST and female candidates, 3 years for OBC candidates) may submit their application (on
plain paper) to the undersigned along with detailed resume (with email, address & contact no.),
attested copies of certificates and work experience or publications latest by 22nd November, 2023.
The date and venue of interview shall be conveyed via email or Phone to the eligible
candidates. No separate call letter will be issued for the interview. No TA/DA will be given for
attending the interview.
-sd-
Dr. Avneet Saini
Principal Investigator
Department of Biophysics
Panjab University, Chandigarh- 160014
Email: avneet@pu.ac.in
